title: feat(samek8): nu same-k reverse fails at k=8: t=14 vs t=26
science: Confirms the same-k failure continues at k=8 on B_24(0) (19649 sites): t(8,0,0)=14, t(8,8,8)=26, so 588 < 676. The two arrivals match the linear forms t_axis = k+6 and t_body = 3k+2 predicted by the path structure in #6787 exactly (14=8+6, 26=24+2), so the k=7 death is systematic rather than a one-off. Another wall shift recorded: t(21,0,0)=27 here vs 29 on B_21.
